title: Q-FLEETMAP-seed: ultrastable/seed is not equal to its source (23 file(s) differ, 15 missing, 0 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/seed is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 23 file(s) differ, 15 missing, 0 only in the copy.

- differ: SECURITY.md, worker/src/apprepos.js, worker/src/auth/store.js, worker/src/criticality.js, worker/src/datagraph.js, worker/src/lane.js, worker/src/lanemerge.js, worker/src/sweeper.js, worker/test/spec-01-data-model.test.js, worker/test/spec-03-tick.test.js, worker/test/spec-26-criticality.test.js, worker/test/spec-26-goals.test.js ...
- missing: worker/test/spec-02-managers.test.js, worker/test/spec-04-plus-share-degrade.test.js, worker/test/spec-04-successors.test.js, worker/test/spec-08-claims.test.js, worker/test/spec-09-caps-ladder.test.js, worker/test/spec-09-throttle-halt-gate.test.js, worker/test/spec-10-repo-creation.test.js, worker/test/spec-11-fleet-runtime.test.js, worker/test/spec-22-contract.test.js, worker/test/spec-24-halt-and-beats.test.js, worker/test/spec-25-tenant-spend.test.js, worker/test/spec-26-planned.test.js ...

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
